caption: The drawing depicts the corner of a room featuring a built-in wooden cabinet structure. The cabinet is set into the corner where two light beige walls meet. The cabinet is vertically oriented, with a tall, rectangular door above two stacked drawers, all featuring small round knobs. The wood of the cabinet, baseboard, chair rail, and a narrow horizontal molding near the ceiling are colored a reddish-brown, distinct from the lighter walls. The floor is a neutral tone, and there are small metal hooks attached to the horizontal molding near the ceiling on both walls. The perspective is straight-on to the corner, emphasizing the geometric lines formed by the walls, cabinetry, and moldings.
title: Closet and Drawers
